desc.briefing: Assembles the morning briefing from activity, runs and memory, delivered to Tasks.
desc.memory-distill: Nightly pass over finished runs; a cheap model distils durable learnings into the vault.
desc.pattern-extract: Scans 30 days of approval decisions and drafts rule proposals into the vault for the briefing.
desc.gap-detect: Watches repeatedly created manual tasks and suggests what could be automated.
desc.agent-factory: Watches repeated orchestrator-fallback runs and proposes a missing specialist agent (pending approval).
